decode_utf8_bytes_to_codepoints: decode UTF-8 encoded bytes into a list of Unicode code points using the cached decode_utf8 function
decode_utf8_leading_char_single: decode the leading UTF-8 character from a byte string and return its code point and remaining bytes
decode_utf8_string_all_codepoints: decode an entire UTF-8 byte string into a list of all Unicode code points
create_partial_utf8_state: create a PartialUTF8 dataclass instance to track partial decoding state with value and n_remain attributes
test_decode_utf8_with_partial: test the decode_utf8 function by passing bytes and a PartialUTF8 start state to get code points
